tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen (Tailwind `bg-background`). Customizable part: background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, sheets, tab bar (`bg-surface`). Customizable part: cards.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, icon-button fill, stepper buttons, quiet fields (`bg-surface-sunken`).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Input and chip borders on surface (`border-line`).

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a card or list group (`border-line-soft`).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline-button border (`border-line-strong`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on background, surface and surface-sunken (`text-ink`).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, inactive tabs, on background, surface and surface-sunken (`text-ink-muted`).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main color: hero header, primary buttons, selected chips and segments, active tab (`bg-primary`, `text-primary`). Customizable parts: header, main buttons, active menu.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Active-tab pill behind the primary icon, selected-option tint (`bg-primary-soft`). Holds 3:1 for icons; put labels beside it on surface, not on it.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (`text-on-primary`). Picked by contrast, never set by hand.

tokens.name: on-primary-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a primary fill, e.g. the weekday on the selected week-strip day (`text-on-primary-muted`).

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Ground of the hero header on Hoje and of the live lesson screen (`bg-header`). Primary in light mode, a deep shade of primary in dark mode so large areas stay calm. Customizable part: header. Known gap kept from the product doc: in Caderno azul and Giz pastel light, the accent + button on header is under 3:1 against it; the button is still found by its icon and position.

tokens.name: on-header
tokens.usage: Text and icons on header (`text-on-header`).

tokens.name: on-header-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on header: the date above the greeting, timer captions (`text-on-header-muted`).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Highlight: Start lesson, the + button, live-timer ring, progress fills (`bg-accent`). Never as text on light surfaces. Customizable part: highlight button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Lesson value panel, "Ao vivo" badge, next-lesson tint (`bg-accent-soft`).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (`text-on-accent`).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft (`text-accent-ink`).

tokens.name: earnings
tokens.usage: Money figures on background and surface (`text-earnings`). Ink in light mode, accent in dark. Customizable part: earnings numbers.

tokens.name: earnings-on-header
tokens.usage: Money figures on header, e.g. the live lesson counter (`text-earnings-on-header`). Accent when it holds 3:1 on header, otherwise on-header. Large text only.

tokens.name: success

tokens.name: success-ink
